segments.comment: Wizard-mode level teleport (^V, then ? for the level menu, then the second page's soko1 entry) to the top Sokoban level. Its Lua runs des.level_init, des.level_flags, des.map, table-form des.monster with appear_as = "obj:boulder", and a des.engraving whose type is "burn" with degrade defaulted, through lspo_level_init, lspo_level_flags, lspo_monster, find_montype, get_table_montype, and lspo_engraving.
